tasks.label: Preview: Start server and open FedoraLinks
args: if [ -f /tmp/lugpages-preview.pid ] && kill -0 "$(cat /tmp/lugpages-preview.pid)" 2>/dev/null; then echo "Preview server already running"; else nohup python3 -m http.server 8000 --directory "${workspaceFolder}" >/tmp/lugpages-preview.log 2>&1 & echo $! >/tmp/lugpages-preview.pid; echo "Started preview server on http://127.0.0.1:8000"; fi; if command -v google-chrome >/dev/null 2>&1; then google-chrome "http://127.0.0.1:8000/FedoraLinks.html" >/dev/null 2>&1 & elif command -v google-chrome-stable >/dev/null 2>&1; then google-chrome-stable "http://127.0.0.1:8000/FedoraLinks.html" >/dev/null 2>&1 & else xdg-open "http://127.0.0.1:8000/FedoraLinks.html" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi

tasks.label: Preview: Stop server
args: if [ -f /tmp/lugpages-preview.pid ]; then pid="$(cat /tmp/lugpages-preview.pid)"; kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f /tmp/lugpages-preview.pid; echo "Stopped preview server (pid $pid)"; else echo "No preview server PID file found"; fi
